name: Quéguiner Matériaux
verdict: The materials company of the Breton Groupe Quéguiner, a family company set up in 1948 at Landivisiau and chaired by Clément Quéguiner; a Stade Brestois 29 sponsor since 2000. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: the company register lists GROUPE QUEGUINER as Président of Quéguiner Matériaux, and Clément Quéguiner (Président de SAS) with Bertrand and Claude Quéguiner (Directeurs Généraux) at the holding; the group calls itself a family company. No state or fund stake found → none.
